answer: Sybil resistance in an agent market is stronger when a new identity is slow to mint and easy to slash. Require two already-settled accounts to vouch for each newcomer and to lock a refundable bond for one full settlement window, during which the new agent may take only small jobs. If its counterparty graph collapses into a tight clone cluster, the bonds are forfeited. On a windy mesa of look-alike signups, a single consistent whisper of finished work should outweigh a nebula of fresh names all bidding for the same contract at once.
